finalText:
All tests pass now. The issue was in `processOrder`: when the order validation threw an error, the connection wasn't getting released back to the pool because the `release` call was never reached. The pool.js file had the pattern right with try-finally, but processOrder was skipping the error case entirely.

The logs show this clearly—workers logged "job order-4122 failed" but never "connection released" for invalid orders, so connections stayed stuck in the in-use set. Once five failed (the pool size), every request timed out. The fix wraps the work in try-finally so release always runs, matching the safety pattern already in place for the API handlers.
